title: Netherlands – Energy-efficiency consultancy services – Verduurzamen woningen Gemeente Zaanstad
description: De gemeente Zaanstad wenst een Overeenkomst af te sluiten met een Opdrachtnemer die inwoners ondersteunt bij het treffen van isolatiemaatregelen aan hun woning. De gemeente Zaanstad vindt het belangrijk dat één herkenbaar bedrijf het langdurig vertrouwd aanspreekpunt is voor bewoners. Eén campagne schept een eenduidig en langdurig herkenbaar beeld. Zie aanbestedingsdocumenten. Om inwoners financieel te ondersteunen bij het treffen van isolatiemaatregelen aan hun woning kunnen twee subsidieregelingen van toepassing zijn: Volkshuisvestingsfonds 1 (VHF1) en Volkshuisvestingsfonds 3 (VHF3): VHF1: Subsidieregeling Verduurzamen Woningen Zaandam Oost 2024 – 2028: Omvang subsidie: ongeveer 250 woningen verduurzaamd naar label B of met 3 labelstappen. De beschikbare lopende resterende subsidie is ongeveer € 3,1 miljoen voor isolatiemaatregelen voor de woningeigenaren en VvE’s. De looptijd van de subsidieregeling is van juni 2025 tot en met 31 december 2028 of totdat het subsidieplafond is bereikt. Vervolg regeling VHF3: Omvang subsidie: 500 woningen verduurzaamd De beschikbare continuerende subsidie is € 11,1 miljoen voor isolatiemaatregelen voor de woningeigenaren en (G)VvE’s. Looptijd regeling: 2027 tot en met 30 juni 2034 of totdat het subsidieplafond is bereikt. Zie aanbestedingsdocumenten.

title: Ireland – Civil engineering consultancy services – Dublin City Council Single Party Framework Agreement for an Integrated Design Team for the Clontarf Flood Defence and Public Realm Project
description: The Contracting Authority, Dublin City Council, intends to establish a Single Party Framework Agreement with a Integrated Design Team to deliver planning, engineering, environmental, stakeholder engagement and other specialist consultancy services for the Clontarf Flood Defence and Public Realm Project (CFDPRP). The Project is located along the Clontarf waterfront in Dublin and encompasses a highly sensitive coastal environment adjoining designated European sites, including Special Areas of Conservation (SAC) and Special Protection Areas (SPA). The Project has been initiated to address existing and future coastal and surface water flood risks while delivering a coordinated programme of public realm enhancement, active travel improvements and environmental benefits. The scheme shall be developed through an integrated design approach that balances flood resilience, climate adaptation, biodiversity, heritage, placemaking, sustainable mobility, environmental protection and stakeholder aspirations. The initial call-off contract under the Framework will require the successful Applicant to undertake all services necessary to develop the Project from commencement through option identification, scheme development, environmental assessment, statutory consent processes and detailed design. This shall include the preparation of all technical studies, surveys, modelling, assessments, reports, designs and application documentation required to secure the necessary approvals and to progress the Project to a stage suitable for procurement and construction. The Framework Agreement may subsequently be utilised by the Contracting Authority to procure additional related services, including procurement support, construction-stage services, post-consent services and other specialist consultancy services associated with the delivery of the Project. The successful Applicant shall be required to develop a fully integrated and coordinated scheme that delivers flood protection, surface water management, active travel and public realm objectives within a single coherent design solution that is environmentally sensitive, climate resilient and appropriate to the strategic importance of the Clontarf waterfront. For further information please refer to documentation available to download from www.etenders.gov.ie Resource ID 8969388 – Input when notice created . Please note that this project is subject to funding.

title: Small animal CT system - Request for information
description: Request for information. (RFI) on small animal computed tomography (CT) imaging system Biomedical Imaging Unit/A. I. Virtanen Institute at the University of Eastern Finland will acquire a small animal CT system. This CT system will be used in connection with other PET and MRI systems in our imaging center, which currently serves as a national core facility for small animal MRI as well as a local core facility for small animal PET. The main application areas currently are neuro and cardiac imaging; however, as a service facility there is need for all kind of imaging applications and technical support for rapid implementation and use of new methodology is important. To this end, we request all interested parties to provide information on suitable CT imaging systems. This RFI is solely for planning purposes. Any proposals submitted in response to this request will not be considered in actual tendering. Estimated total value Value excluding VAT and including customs cannot exceed €215,997.00 Time of acquisition Fall 2022 Necessary requirements: 1. The system must form fully functioning, standalone CT system 2. System must allow acquiring in vivo data from adult mice and rats 3. The system must have CE marking 4. Delivery time of the system is max. 6 months from the date of the purchase order 5. The supplier must provide at least the following: a. detailed specifications e.g. system dimensions (length, width, height), weight, FOV (axial and transaxial, min and max) with corresponding spatial resolution, voltage range, scanning modes (circular, helical), dual-energy option, dynamic imaging option, gating options (respiratory, cardiac) b. a reference list with at least 2 equivalent installations c. detailed coverage and period of the warranty d. budgetary quote Please send your proposal by e-mail to hankinnat@uef.fi by March 7, 2022.
